fr.considerations: The target property at 862 Bethel Dr is a commercial building in a mixed industrial area with a single confirmed vehicle entrance off the eastern side at approximately (71.7, 47.3), making it the primary — and apparently only — vehicular access point for emergency apparatus. A fence along the western edge limits lateral approach from that side, and dense storage areas adjacent to the building reduce available maneuvering space near the structure. Tree clusters and scattered vegetation near the northern approach partially obstruct sightlines and may impede aerial ladder placement. The parking lot on the eastern side offers some staging potential but is shared and may be congested with parked vehicles.
fr.recommendations: Responding units should approach via the eastern vehicle entrance, as it appears to be the sole confirmed access point; confirm whether the entrance is gated or controlled before dispatch. Stage apparatus in the eastern parking lot area, keeping the driveway clear for additional units and EMS. The fenced western perimeter should be considered a barrier to rapid secondary access — crews should identify any gate or breach point in the fence during initial size-up. Avoid staging near the storage area adjacent to the building due to potential obstruction and unknown stored materials.

wildfire.considerations: The target property at 862 Bethel Dr features a commercial building with an attached roof structure surrounded by scattered vegetation to the north and a tree cluster to the east, both of which reduce defensible space clearance and present ember-catching and ignition exposure risks. A storage area adjacent to the main structure on the west side introduces additional combustible fuel load in close proximity to the building. The fenced perimeter on the western boundary partially limits fire spread pathways but also constrains firefighter access and egress under fire conditions. Dry, undeveloped land visible to the north and northeast of the property, along with sparse vegetation continuity across the parcel, creates conditions for surface fire spread toward the structure.
wildfire.recommendations: Clear scattered vegetation to the north and maintain a minimum 30-foot defensible space zone around all structures, prioritizing the removal of dead or dry plant material nearest the building. Relocate or enclose combustible materials in the storage area away from the structure walls and roof overhangs to reduce direct ignition risk. Evaluate the fenced perimeter for gaps or gates that could facilitate firefighter ingress and egress on the western side during an emergency response. Ensure the vehicle entrance and parking lot areas remain unobstructed to allow emergency apparatus staging and rapid access to the structure under fire conditions.
